pages.ld_description:
Classic toys from Fisher Price that every parent and grandparent will remember, re-released for a new generation to discover and enjoy.
Introduced in 1957, the Fisher-Price Pull-A-Tune Xylophone is musical classic. Tap the eight rainbow coloured bars with the mallet to make beautiful music. The mallet is attached by a string so it never gets lost. It’s on wheels, so kids can pull it along wherever they go.
Suitable for age 18 months+
